review.title: GENIA and HAMBI: bounded reference mappings and complete ambiguity sets
review.independence_basis: Source contexts, selected native outcomes, local previews and actual M5 candidates were independently read before application. Community reviewed GENIA's actual candidate and history configuration; a separate peer reviewed HAMBI's actual candidate and history configuration. The shared engine, checker, diagnostic builder and exporter already have independent reviews and mutation controls. This authored diagnostic is self-review of two scoped technical corrections, not an independent full scientific assessment.
review.summary: GENIA now carries eight species-reference blocks and one complete three-way ambiguity; HAMBI carries seven species-reference blocks and eight complete ambiguity sets. Their nine and fifteen selected descriptors respectively changed status through the unchanged native engine, with two inline events per record and one native sidecar each. Existing source identities, biological assertions, evidence, notes and old history remain unchanged. Generic database correspondence does not establish a study-stock genome or resolve prior scientific limitations.
review.scope_description: Two explicitly selected whole records, CommunityMech:000352 and CommunityMech:000423, assessed only for the declared GTDB blocks, statuses, complete candidate lists and actual provenance. Sixteen scoped native commands passed on the accepted M5 bytes. HAMBI's unselected Paraniabella descriptor at index 14 remains unchanged and unresolved.
review.selection: The remaining two records in the separately prepared 443/352/423 lane, after the complete MWF001 canary, saved input checkpoint, strict proof controls and publication. Exactly two records are reviewed here. The earlier MWF001 bundle remains separate and immutable; unrelated records and denied transfer groups are excluded.
limitations: This is a partial technical database-correspondence diagnostic with scientific_review:false. Completed status concerns this bounded diagnostic only. It is not full scientific approval, source-reference coverage, generated-page validation, final corpus QC, campaign completion or issue closure.

GENIA's eight reference blocks use one species-name route for Atlantibacter and seven exact species-ID routes. Reported totals/fractions are 2/1.0, 8/1.0, 562/0.98, 336/0.97, 236/0.95, 98/0.97, 163/0.85 and 2/1.0 in the selected block order. The notation means total genomes and reported fraction, not a support numerator. Species results provide no support_genomes; no numerator is reconstructed from rounded fractions. Pseudomonas fulva's 0.85 is not unanimity.

GENIA's Paenibacillus descriptor retains polymyxa, polymyxa_B and polymyxa_C without a single classification block. Generic alternative clusters do not identify the experimental isolate or count stocks. The paper's 45 sequenced isolates, nine-member roster and BioProject are distinct from the reference populations; missing stock codes and uninspected assembly-to-member links are not invented.

GENIA's predicted enzyme/network complementarity remains HYPOTHESIZED, relative DNA composition is not viable abundance, and the daily ratio intervention retains its PARTIAL removal arrow and handling confound. Separate-treatment versus mixed-treatment removal figures, PFOS/atrazine denominator and method questions, non-graph roles and missing raw/supplement reconciliation remain outside this correction. Issue 1468 and the immutable batch 42 assessment are not resolved or promoted.

HAMBI's seven reference blocks use three species-name routes (Kluyvera, Sphingobium and Cupriavidus) and four exact species-ID routes. Reported totals/fractions are Citrobacter 393/1.0, Kluyvera 2/1.0, Sphingobium 15/1.0, Aeromonas 523/0.99, Bordetella 76/1.0, Cupriavidus 2/1.0 and Microvirga 3/1.0. These are total genomes and reported fractions, not exact support counts, community abundances or collection-stock genome assignments.

HAMBI preserves all ordered alternatives for Pseudomonas putida (15), Agrobacterium (4), Comamonas (3), Morganella (2), Sphingobacterium (2), Pseudomonas chlororaphis (3), Paracoccus (2) and Stenotrophomonas (11). The alternative counts are neither experimental member counts nor reference-genome denominators. All sixteen named HAMBI stocks remain distinct; index 14 Paraniabella yanshanensis stays null/UNRESOLVED without a label rollback or absence claim.

HAMBI's historical unavailable-crosswalk notes describe the earlier curation and remain intact. Generic routes do not reproduce the source's WGS-derived 16S mapping. The sixteen-day/eight-cycle inoculum experiment does not prove persistence of all members; OD-scaled abundance is not viable counting, and controlled carbon-dependent outcomes do not selectively establish trait/pH mediation or alternative stable states. The batch 50 assessment, open discussions and Hanford/C6 boundaries remain unchanged.

Source examination covered the complete current records and historical callers/ledgers, selected retained primary GENIA isolation, sequencing, final roster and network passages, HAMBI's complete stock roster, serial-transfer, 16S and separate-assay passages, and the captured native crosswalk/local-authority outputs. No new full-paper scientific audit, collection-catalog search, separate supplement inspection, original figure-pixel analysis, raw sequencing, assembly assignment, analytical mass balance or source-code reanalysis was performed.

Source reporting and binding ran locally at f18ca5b7f83eae0a9c8f537bdde6703760fee90e with preparation changes disclosed. Actual staging, guarded application and all sixteen native commands ran on frozen M5 preparation revision 9b770f6603aa2714fc4f7f317768d8857fbb8d1e using Python 3.13.2 and frozen offline dependencies. Expected applied records, sidecars and metadata are working-tree changes; no clean final-QC claim is made.

Crosswalk SHA-256 is 761d5537a7edb4b0133e88e7bbc85570cf3cb6f2555b9f9ce6cca3e1056a0ddd. Its mtime is not an upstream release. Local authority observations retain file identity/stat provenance without an invented full-database digest. Both native term runs report Validation passed without an assertion denominator. The earlier route-layout refusal and corrected species-fraction wording remain under issues 2913/2916. GENIA's initial M5 free stage plan refused a missing source-proof file before any write; the exact file was transferred and rehashed before a successful new plan and actual stage.

Complete saved-input checkpoints, strict saved-successor controls and historical caller composition are subsequent acceptance steps. In particular, batch 42 must preserve the existing Fucoidan449 successor and Transwell historical chain, while batch 50 must compose the separately published C6 successor without changing its current biological predicates or immutable ledger. None of those later outcomes is assumed by this draft.

evidence.locator: Actual before/after, externally pinned candidate/receipt, captured source inputs, two native inline events and native history sidecar
evidence.summary: The independently reviewed M5 candidate was applied exactly. Only declared GTDB fields and actual appended events changed; original biological content, source statements and history remained intact.

evidence.locator: GENIA node/edge decisions, arithmetic limitations and open_nongraph_followups; captured batch42 caller's GENIA, Fucoidan and Transwell predicates

assessments.topic: Nine source species without invented stock or assembly identities
assessments.summary: All nine encoded source species remain unchanged. Source sequencing and BioProject context are distinguished from an assembly-to-member identity that was not established. Existing roles, abundance labels and predicted mechanisms are preserved without recertification.

assessments.topic: Eight reference populations and full three-way ambiguity
assessments.summary: The eight blocks reproduce the bound native ID/name outcomes and reported totals/fractions, including the 0.85 fulva fraction. Paenibacillus retains all three ordered alternatives and no single block. Species fractions supply no exact support numerator, stock abundance or experimental genome assignment.

assessments.topic: Actual bounded correction and preserved historical scientific scope
assessments.summary: Actual application and sidecar bind nine changed statuses, eight blocks, one ambiguity set and two inline events. All eight scoped commands passed; strict validation scanned one file with zero errors. The old scientific limitations and all current biological predicates remain; strict saved-proof and caller controls follow separately.

records.label: Seven generic reference blocks and eight complete ambiguity sets across sixteen preserved stocks

evidence.summary: The source names all sixteen HAMBI stocks and distinguishes serial community passage, WGS-derived 16S mapping and separate trait/pH assays. Those identifiers and methods do not independently select generic GTDB alternatives for a stock.

evidence.locator: Fifteen selected occurrences with complete native_result, classify_status, lookup rows/indexes and authority observations; unselected index14 limitation in historical_guard_assessment
evidence.summary: Seven native reference blocks and eight complete ordered ambiguity sets are supported for their generic descriptors. Paraniabella index14 remains unchanged with no result. Totals, rounded fractions and alternative counts do not identify collection-stock genomes or culture abundance.

evidence.locator: Actual before/after, externally pinned reviewed candidate/receipt, captured inputs, two native inline events and appended history sidecar
evidence.summary: The exact reviewed M5 candidate was persisted. Fifteen declared descriptors changed; all sixteen stocks, index14, original notes, biological content and old history remained unchanged. Native stdout processes sixteen taxa while the event records fifteen changed entries.

evidence.locator: HAMBI node decision and source/causal limitations; complete captured batch50 current biological, roster, cache and historical predicates
evidence.summary: The historical assessment remains literal. Input membership does not establish endpoint persistence, OD-scaled abundance is not viable counting, and carbon outcomes do not selectively establish mechanism. Hanford/C6 scientific constraints are outside this correction and remain protected.

assessments.topic: Sixteen distinct HAMBI stocks and unchanged null descriptor
assessments.summary: All sixteen stock designations and source names are preserved. Generic reference matching does not reproduce the paper's WGS-derived 16S workflow or identify an individual culture assembly. Index14 remains unresolved without taxon-absence inference or replacement of its valid current label.

assessments.topic: Seven reference populations and eight complete alternative sets
assessments.summary: The seven blocks retain their three name/four ID routes and exact reported totals/fractions, including nonunanimous Aeromonas 0.99. Every alternative remains ordered and complete for the eight ambiguous descriptors. No ambiguous block is selected, exact numerator reconstructed or stock count inferred.

assessments.topic: Persisted native correction preserves source and biological boundaries
assessments.summary: Actual application and native sidecar bind seven blocks, eight candidate lists, fifteen changed statuses and two inline events. Eight scoped native commands passed, with one-file strict validation reporting zero errors. Old source notes, discussions, experimental/causal boundaries and history remain exact; later saved-proof and composed caller controls are not assumed.
